content.short: BitOK provides AML, KYT, KYC, wallet monitoring, and investigation tools for crypto businesses.
content.description: BitOK is a crypto compliance and monitoring platform. Its site describes AML solutions, KYT office tools, wallet and transaction monitoring, graph-based investigations, and risk analytics for businesses and individuals. In the TON context, it is relevant for compliance teams that need to screen addresses, monitor flows, and investigate suspicious activity. BitOK offers cutting-edge solutions for cryptocurrency monitoring, AML, KYC, and KYT. The app presents our products, approved by market leaders, crypto monitoring for better aml, and graph for investigations as core parts of the workflow.
